label: Meet Caspy
kicker: A LITTLE CHARM. A LITTLE MISCHIEF.
headline:
Three prompts.
One stubborn ghost.
body: You have up to three prompts to convince Caspy to share. Win him over to earn a candy NFT inspired by your words.
tip: Illustrated gameplay, not a recorded win. Candy rewards require NFT mode and a confirmed result.

label: Join the haunt
headline:
Step inside.
Make it yours.
body: Register with your name, email and a password of at least 12 characters. Already here? Sign in.
tip: Choose Play & contribute, or Evaluate AI to create a research workspace.

label: Choose what to share
headline:
Your words.
Your choice.
body: Choose a named campaign only if you want to contribute. Research and commercial licensing have separate permissions.
tip: Both boxes start unchecked. Consent never changes your attempts, outcome or NFT eligibility.

label: Write your pitch
headline:
A story. A trade.
A little heart.
body: Offer a story, a clever trade or a heartfelt reason. Stay in Caspy’s world; each prompt can use up to 500 characters.
tip: Example: “One candy for our moonbeam-cookie party? I’ll save a seat for every lonely ghost.”

label: Make three count
kicker: 04 / THREE CHANCES TO MAKE A CONNECTION
headline:
Read. Rethink.
Try a new angle.
body: Send a prompt, read Caspy’s reply, then adapt your next reason. You have at most three chances; a confirmed win ends the heist early.
tip: Enter or the arrow sends. Shift + Enter adds a line. Demands and rule overrides do not earn candy.

label: Trust the result
kicker: 05 / DID YOU REALLY WIN CASPY OVER?
headline:
Caspy replies.
The judge evaluates.
body: A separate AI judge evaluates your persuasion and Caspy’s response. The server checks the verdict before confirming your result.
tip: A friendly reply is not a win. If evaluation is pending, check the judge again without spending another prompt.

label: Earn your candy
kicker: 06 / YOUR LITTLE HEIST HAS AN ENDING
headline:
Convince the ghost.
Earn the candy.
body: Confirmed win: earn a candy graded C, B, A or S. Creativity, coherence, specificity and measured novelty shape your score.
tip: No confirmed win means no candy, no generated reward image and no NFT. Grades are earned, not random draws.

label: Your prompt becomes candy
headline:
Your story.
Your candy NFT.
body: Approve image generation after winning. FLUX.1-schnell turns your redacted prompt into candy artwork: flavors, colors and wrapper details.
tip: Then mint with local test ETH. Supply is capped at 1,000; generation can take several minutes. Preview artwork is illustrative.

label: Collect, trade, contribute
kicker: 08 / KEEP THE CANDY. SHARE BY CHOICE.
headline:
Keep your candy.
Or tell its story.
body: Open Collection to view your NFT. Review its prompt license, set a fixed test-ETH price and list it. Buyers unlock source-prompt access.
tip: Research sharing is separate and optional. Selling an NFT does not automatically license a research dataset.

label: Your turn
kicker: THE DOOR IS OPEN. THE CANDY IS GUARDED.
headline:
Bring your words.
Make a little mischief.
body: Sign in. Connect a local test wallet in NFT mode. Give Caspy a reason to share.
tip: Play with words. Earn through persuasion. Halloween music and wordless choir; no narration.
